message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order for safety and efficiency. | # | Task | Key Tips | |---|------|----------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | • List your use case (gaming, video editing, office).
• Decide on a budget (e.g., $800–$1500).
• Make a parts list (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, PSU, case, cooling). | | 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | • Phillips screwdriver (magnetic tip).
• Anti‑static wrist strap or mat.
• Clean, flat surface. | | 3 | **Choose a Case** | • Size: ATX, Micro‑ATX, Mini‑ITX.
• Airflow: front intake, rear exhaust.
• Cable management: plenty of space. | | 4 | **Install the Power Supply (PSU)** | • Place PSU at bottom rear (most cases).
• Secure with screws.
• Route cables: keep them tidy, leave room for airflow. | | 5 | **Mount the Motherboard** | • Align standoffs with motherboard holes.
• Screw in gently.
• Check that all ports line up with case cutouts. | | 6 | **Install the CPU** | • Lift the CPU socket lever.
• Align the corner marker on the CPU with the socket.
• Gently place, lower lever. | | 7 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install CPU Cooler** | • Small pea‑size amount on CPU center.
• Attach cooler (fan‑side down).
• Connect fan header to motherboard. | | 8 | **Insert RAM** | • Open DIMM slots.
• Align notch, press until clicks.
• Verify all sticks seated. | | 9 | **Mount Storage (SSD/HDD)** | • 2.5″ SSD: use mounting bracket or drive cage.
• 3.5″ HDD: secure with screws.
• Connect SATA data + power cables. | |10 | **Install the Graphics Card (GPU)** | • Remove rear expansion slot covers.
• Insert GPU into top PCI‑e x16 slot.
• Secure with screws.
• Connect 6‑pin/8‑pin power from PSU. | |11 | **Connect Front Panel & USB Ports** | • Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout.
• Connect power button, reset, USB, audio, etc. | |12 | **Cable Management** | • Tidy up cables with zip ties.
• Route cables through cable‑management holes.
• Ensure no obstruction to airflow. | |13 | **First Boot & BIOS Setup** | • Power on.
• Enter BIOS (usually DEL or F2).
• Set boot priority to SSD.
• Enable XMP for RAM. | |14 | **Install Operating System (OS)** | • Create bootable USB (Windows 10/11, Ubuntu, etc.).
• Boot from USB, follow installer.
• Install drivers (GPU, chipset). | |15 | **Test & Benchmark** | • Run stress tests (Prime95, FurMark).
• Monitor temperatures (HWMonitor).
• Adjust fan curves if needed. | |16 | **Final Checks** | • Verify all fans spin.
• Ensure no loose screws.
• Clean dust filters. | --- #### Quick Parts Checklist (Example for a Mid‑Range Gaming Build) | Component | Suggested Model | Approx. Price | |-----------|-----------------|---------------| | CPU | AMD Ryzen 5 7600X | $200 | | Motherboard | MSI B650M PRO‑VDH WIFI | $120 | | GPU | NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti | $400 | | RAM | 16GB DDR5 6000MHz | $90 | | SSD | Samsung 970 EVO Plus 1TB NVMe | $110 | | PSU | Corsair RM750x 750W 80+ Gold | $120 | | Case | NZXT H510 | $70 | | Cooler | Cooler Master Hyper 212 RGB | $40 | | **Total** | | **≈$1,210** | *(Prices vary; adjust based on your budget.)* --- #### Common Pitfalls & How to Avoid Them | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | **Short‑circuit** | Use anti‑static wrist strap; double‑check standoffs. | | **Overheating** | Ensure proper airflow; use quality thermal paste. | | **Boot failure** | Verify CPU socket orientation; check RAM seating. | | **Fan noise** | Use fan speed control software; replace noisy fans. | | **Cable clutter** | Plan cable routes early; use zip ties. | --- #### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – Build planner & price comparison. - **YouTube Channels** – Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents, Paul's Hardware. - **Manuals** – Keep motherboard, case, PSU manuals handy (PDFs online). Happy building! If you hit a snag, let me know which step and I’ll help troubleshoot.
message.reasoning: User asks: "How to build a new PC?" They want instructions. We can provide a step-by-step guide. No function call needed.
